title: cyclobalanopsis subhinoidea

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Cyclobalanopsis subhinoidea include anti-cancer, anti-oxidative, and anti-inflammatory effects, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
